Taylor M.: Hey all 1st day is 5/2 and I had a few benefits/payroll logistics Qs: 1) My offer said a $3k relocation amount 1is that paid with first paycheck or separate? 2) There's a national holiday my first week will the commuter *virtual* card still be ready? 3) Domestic partner enrollment docs what's accepted?

Kim (People Ops): Welcome Taylor! Short answers: 1) Relocation is typically a one-time payment on the first payroll after active status, but we can split if needed. 2) Virtual commuter cards often activate faster than physical ones but still require payroll activation + direct deposit/I-9 clearance. Holiday may delay activation by a few days. 3) DP enrollment: signed DP affidavit + one supporting doc (joint lease, joint bank, utility) dated within last 60 days.

Oscar (Payroll): To add: relocation is processed as supplemental income and shows as a separate line item. If you need the funds earlier we can review split payments; tax withholding differs slightly between single vs split runs. If you complete I-9 + direct deposit by EOD Wed we can target the payroll that processes on 5/15 (paid 5/22). DM me state + offer ID and I'll flag it.

Taylor M.: I selected virtual commuter card. If I upload docs today, is it realistic to expect activation before Thu holiday?

Oscar (Payroll): Possibly if onboarding documents clear today and approvals propagate, virtual card can be enabled same day. Worst case it's live the following business day.

Julian (Benefits): For DP coverage: signed affidavit + one supporting doc as Kim mentioned. Acceptable PDFs: joint lease, bank stmt, or shared utility. If you don't have joint docs, we can accept a notarized affidavit paired with a secondary doc. Enroll within 30 days of your start date via benefits portal.

Taylor M.: Uploaded DP affidavit and a bank stmt just now, portal shows "pending verification" should I do anything else?

Kim (People Ops): Got it, thanks. Pending verification means Benefits team needs to confirm the supporting doc. Julian, can you fast-track?

Julian (Benefits): Yep I see the upload. I'll mark it for expedited verification; expect status update within 24 hours.

Oscar (Payroll): Also flag: commuter stipend tax treatment varies by state. If you're in NY or CA it may be subject to state withholding. DM me payroll state and I can give a net estimate for the relocation + stipend.

welcome-bot: Reminder: New hire tasks: complete I-9, set up direct deposit, submit benefits docs. Benefits enrollment deadline: 30 days from start.

Taylor M.: Thanks all I'll DM Oscar my state and keep an eye on the portal. Appreciate the help :raised_hands:
